question: Should OpenClaw adopt `copilot-developer-cli` as the GitHub Copilot runtime identity for all existing profiles without enterprise-tenant live proof?
rationale: The code and public-credential proof support the repair, but tenant-specific Copilot policy can differ and the change affects stored OAuth profiles plus every provider transport.

options.title: Obtain enterprise validation
options.body: Run a redacted GitHub Enterprise Copilot catalog and inference check after rebasing, then merge if the tenant endpoint and runtime identity both succeed.

options.title: Accept the documented public-contract evidence
options.body: Approve the change without enterprise live proof, explicitly accepting that enterprise policy remains a post-merge follow-up.

recommendation.title: Obtain enterprise validation
recommendation.body: Run a redacted GitHub Enterprise Copilot catalog and inference check after rebasing, then merge if the tenant endpoint and runtime identity both succeed.
